stories.title: Israel destroys Gaza warehouse supplies for malnourished children and pregnant women
stories.summary: Israel destroys Gaza warehouse supplies for malnourished children and pregnant women An Israeli military strike targeting a nearby building destroyed a warehouse storing nutritional supplies for malnourished children, pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers in central Gaza’s Deir el-Balah, Medical Aid for Palestinians (MAP) said in a statement on Tuesday. The warehouse belongs to Ard El Insan (AEI), a local humanitarian organisation working with MAP to support about 60 medical points serving up to 100 women and children daily.
